name: Lucid Chocolate Muscat 78% Dark, 50g
description:
Lucid Chocolatier aims to provide a selection of quality chocolate bars that exceed the standard for artisan chocolates in New Zealand, created with the utmost respect for the heritage of the cocoa, production techniques, and the environment of their beautiful country.

Utilising infusion, they have created a chocolate bar that cerebrates one of Australia’s most decorated dessert wines, Muscat. Rich in deep raisin flavours, the Australian Rutherglen Muscat is the perfect companion for their Chuncho cacao showcased as a complex 78% format.

Their own authentic take on a chocolate bar that has become a staple all around the world.

name: Lucid Chocolate Port 68% Dark, 50g
description:

Their now legendary Port bar. The chocolate bar that cemented them as one of the top makers in the country, and the bar that first broke through into international award success. By utilising infusion, they have created a potent chocolate bar which carries the flavors of Port. They submerge nibs from their Marañon beans in a quality 10-year-old Tawny Port featuring developed and charismatic flavors. Produced in Portugal by Taylor's, one of the first historic wine houses, then matched in rural New Zealand with quality beans from the Marañon valley in Peru, this is an extraordinarily unique offering.

description:

name: Lucid Chocolate Sauternes 72% Dark, 50g
description:
Lucid Chocolatier aims to provide a selection of quality chocolate bars that exceed the standard for artisan chocolates in New Zealand, created with the utmost respect for the heritage of the cocoa, production techniques, and the environment of their beautiful country.

Johnty (one of New Zealand's most successful chocolate makers) recalls the first time he drank Sauternes vividly. In 2019, at the end of one of the best meals of his life at Jano Bistro in Wellington, dessert was served, and with it a curious glass of soft golden-orange coloured wine. The sommelier explained it was a sweet wine from France, with notes of stone fruits, citrus and honey. Perplexed at the concept, Johnty drank. He then smiled in amazement. With a definitive taste of apricot and honey, a new interest had been discovered, and in retrospect, this bar was born.

name: Lucid Chocolate Sheep milk 54% Dark Milk, 50g
description:
Lucid Chocolatier aims to provide a selection of quality chocolate bars that exceed the standard for artisan chocolates in New Zealand, created with the utmost respect for the heritage of the cocoa, production techniques, and the environment of their beautiful country.

Fernglen Farm is a sheep milk farming family neighbouring Lucid’s production site. They have been producing premium sheep milk for years, and Lucid has been testing chocolate with it since their inception. Cameron, who pioneered their move to sheep milking from conventional farming, has been friends with Johnty since youth. This bar is a tribute to locality and friendship, through the medium of soft and creamy sheep milk.

name: Ocelot Black Cherry 70% Dark Chocolate Bar, 100g
description:
Ocelot was created with the express attention of producing beautiful and delicious chocolate with minimal environmental impact. All of their chocolate is certified organic, made with unrefined cane sugar, and never contains preservatives or emulsifiers. In both 2023 and 2024 their sister company, and supplier Original Beans were awarded the Good Egg Award for World’s Most Ethical Chocolate: the only chocolate company to achieve green eggs in every category!

The Black Cherry bar is a smooth, rich, organic dark chocolate made with beans grown in Virunga National Park, Eastern Congo. The fruity, smoky flavours of this chocolate pair perfectly with tart and fragrant black cherries: a classic and luxurious combination.

name: KESSHO Black Sesame White Choc
description:

name: Kessho Ceremonial Matcha White Chocolate Bar, 60g

Hints of seaweed and toasted rice provide a balanced, aromatic flavor. This matcha white chocolate captures the essence of Japanese tea ceremonies, delivering a unique flavor.

name: Kessho Genmaicha White Chocolate Bar, 68g

The result is a perfect capture of genmaicha's essence: toasted grains harmoniously blending with delicate tea notes, creating a Japanese-inspired white chocolate experience.

name: Kessho Guava Lime 57% Bar, 60g

The combination of tart fruits and deep chocolate creates a vibrant harmony, with a subtle warmth of chili appearing at the finish-transforming a beloved street snack into a refined chocolate experience.

name: Kessho Hojicha White Chocolate Bar, 60g

The result is a well-balanced,aromatic white chocolate bar that captures the essence of a tranquil tea break.Enjoy it at any time of the day.

name: Kessho Lychee Rose 48% Bar, 65g

name: Kessho Porcini 60% Bar, 60g

The result is a silky chocolate that opens with caramel sweetness before revealing layers of forest floor, roasted nuts, and a savory depth.

name: Kessho Rasberry 57% Bar, 60g

The natural tang and salt of the plum play perfectly against the chocolate, creating a soul-satisfying harmony of contrasting yet complementary flavors.

name: Kessho Tanzania 70% Bar, 60g

With pronounced notes of ripe berries, tangy raspberries, and a hint of citrus, this chocolate offers a vibrant and sophisticated taste journey. Perfect for those who appreciate the intricate and bold profiles of fine dark chocolate.

name: Kessho Yuzu 56% Bar, 60g

Made with yuzu harvested in Miyazaki Prefecture in Japan and cacao beans from Kokoa Kamili in Tanzania, this indulgent treat is sure to tantalize your taste buds.The tangy flavor of the yuzu perfectly complements the unique fruit-forward notes of the Tanzanian cacao. This bar is unforgettable.

name: Hogarth Bischoc 46% Bar, 70g
description:
From Nelson, New Zealand, Hogarth sources the highest quality cacao beans from around the world to create small batches of chocolate using traditional techniques. They sort, roast, crush and classify, winnow, grind and conche, age, melt, temper, mold, and wrap all by hand.

In this bar, they grind the spiced, caramelised biscuits directly into the chocolate giving the bar a signature Biscoff flavour. A whole biscuit is immersed into the back of the bar for a satisfying chocolately crunch. All their chocolate is made using directly traded, traceable and slave free cocoa beans from the first carbon neutral cocoa farm Hacienda Victoria.

name: Hogarth Black Velvet 72% Bar, 70g

Their Buttered Toast and Sea Salt chocolate bar won the Supreme Award at the New Zealand Chocolate Awards in 2018 and is their best-selling chocolate bar. It combines cacao from Ecuador, butter, and crunchy bits of Vogel’s bread (a premium NZ mixed grain loaf).

name: Hogarth Pina Colada 72% Bar, 70g
description:

Who doesn't love a Piña Colada? Hogarth wanted to recreate that iconic flavor of Rum, Pineapple and Coconut for this bar.

First they drenched the cocoa nibs in dark rum and soaked them for a few weeks to infuse the flavor, then they dried out the nibs and made a 72% dark chocolate. When molding the bar they sprinkle toasted coconut and dried pineapple on the back, adding a glazed cherry to finish this delicious cocktail inspired bar.

name: Hogarth Root Beer 68% Bar, 70g
description:

Hogarth created the classic Root Beer flavour by combining three spices, sarsaparilla, liquorice and ginger with cacao and orange. The resulting chocolate is wonderfully aromatic and refreshing, with candied orange pieces for a sweet zesty bite.

name: Give Chocolate
tagline: A hand-picked selection of the best chocolate!
description:

You tell that person you want to get some nice chocolate bars for your chocolate loving family member, friend, colleague or...yourself. They quickly pick out the bars you need and BAM! These hazelnuts are slow roasted then tumbled in SOMA's lovely dark chocolate blend made with cacao from their favorite farms and growing regions.

The most beautiful hazelnuts of all are the Tonde Gentile delle Langhe (TGL) hazelnuts from the Piedmont region of Italy. The indigenous trees are protected, the rich land where they grow is a UNESCO heritage site and the birthplace of the Slowfood movement.

TGLs are sweet and delicate with a captivating hazelnut flavour. The Piedmont region is famous for their hazelnuts and chocolate, cue the chocolatemakers.

name: SOMA Semuliki Forest Uganda 70% Bar, 65g
description:

The cacao beans used to make this chocolate is grown by 500 smallholder farmers in the lush growing region of Bundibugyo in Uganda. Each farm is 1-2 hectares, either owned as family land or leased from other farmers. This chocolate bar is community supported. Chocolatemakers are given an opportunity to pay a bonus per kg to be used directly to support the farmers that make Semuliki Forest cacao possible. This year the fund will be used to pay school fees for the farmer’s children.

And the chocolate...its amazing with notes of raisins, figs, chocolate cake, walnuts & vanilla.

name: SOMA Stratus Bar, 65g
description:
Soma was founded in 2003 in Toronto, Canada. A rarity in the industry, Soma is adept at both chocolate making, and also a fantastic chocolatier. They were one of the first to tackle the micro batch chocolate bar production and their high quality chocolate bars have been awarded multiple times over the years.

SOMA's original idea was to infuse cacao with oak. After an inspired talk with their friends at Stratus Vineyards in Niagara-on-the-Lake, winemaker J-L Groux sent over an oak barrel partially filled with the residual yeast and grape skins from the winemaking process known as "lees." They roasted up a batch of cacao beans and added the roasted nibs to the barrel, rolling it around to make sure things were well mixed.

3 months later, they had a chocolate bar with notes of grapes, miso, wild honey, sour dough, lychee, walnuts & honeysuckle.

name: Ara Chocolat Amandes and Roses, 70% El Salvador
description: Ara Chocolat, founded by a Venezuelan couple, Andrés and Sabrina, is a micro batch Parisian chocolate shop and one of the few bean-to-bar chocolate makers in France. They make chocolates from the beans that their Chef Chocolatier, Andrés, carefully chooses and buys directly from small cocoa growers and cooperatives in Latin America. Porcelana, a strain of the renowned Criollo cocoa variety is the gold standard for chocolate. The beans are a white to violet color reminiscent of pure porcelain, hence the name. This bar strikes the perfect balance between fruity acidity and pleasant bitterness. Earthy & nutty, it is laced with brambly fruit, amazing acidity, subtle sweetness and a melt in your mouth texture. In short, this chocolate is an occasion.

name: Fossa Bak Kut Teh Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

An iconic dish of Singapore, Bak Kut Teh or “meat bone tea” is a hearty stew made with pork ribs and a mix of aromatic spices. The Teochew style popular in Singapore is garlicky and peppery.

Our version is made with a base of fudgy Bolivian cacao from Alto Beni region blended with a powerful spice mix of Sarawak white pepper, Indonesian black pepper, anise, cinnamon and a healthy dose of garlic. It is a heartwarming blend of spice and soul.

name: Fossa Cheng Tng Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Cheng Tng (roughly translated to clear soup) is a beloved traditional dessert in hot and humid Singapore. Sweet and refreshing, it is usually made with ingredients with cooling properties such as dried longan, persimmon and candied winter melon.

In this bar, we used a smoky cacao from Pinalum Village located in Malekula Island, Vanuatu. The beans were naturally “smoked” by storing beside wood fire-dried copra, lending a flavour that reminds one of smoked longan. Mixed with a variety of seeds and fruits, the chocolate is nostalgic, and wonderfully soothing — just like the dessert that inspired it.

Chrysanthemum is a symbol of longevity and rejuvenation. Brewed as a tea, it is believed to have cooling and cleansing properties. Prized chrysanthemum buds sourced from Zhejiang, China, are blended with fruity cacao from Rehoboth Estate, bringing forth elegant floral aroma and notes of honey with a long sweet lingering finish.

name: Fossa Da Hong Pao Wuyi Cliff Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Da Hong Pao, the most famous of all Wuyi cliff teas, is a careful blend of specially selected cultivars to create the deep aroma, smooth sweetness and rock-grown character. Rou Gui provides a strong structured body while Jin Mudan and Rui Xiang lift the aroma with fruity-floral fragrance. Two rounds of medium level roasting brought out the depth and complexity of these teas from the Zhengyan core area of Wuyi Mountains.

Paired with creamy and nutty cacao from Triang, Malaysia, the flavour is balanced, layered and richly aromatic.

name: Fossa Dancong Duck Sh$t Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

A collaboration with rare tea curator Pekoe & Imp, this chocolate bar is made with a dancong tea from the Guangdong Province of China, known as Ya Shi Xiang. The name literally translates to “duck sh%t.” Legend has it that the farmer who cultivated the tea intentionally gave it a revolting name in order to hide the secret to his delicious tea. Fortunately, the flavor is nothing like the name suggests. Pleasantly floral on the nose with notes of fruit and malt, don’t make the mistake of judging this chocolate by its cover.

name: Fossa Full Bloom 54% Dark Milk Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Full Bloom is a geranium scented creamy dark milk chocolate made with fruity Filipino cacao and adorned with a bed of assorted edible flowers. Treat yourself to this visual and soulful delight!

This is a special collaboration with Lim Joo Huat, a Singaporean third-generation fresh produce wholesale distributor with a legacy dating back to the 1960s. Working directly with farmers, Lim Joo Huat is renown for their top-quality fresh produce.

name: Fossa Gardenia Flower Green Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar features green teas of the Fuding Da Bai cultivar infused with Gardenia Flowers from Qianwei country in Sichuan using a traditional floral infusion method. Fresh flowers are layered over tea leaves ina laborious process that is repeated seven times to achieve complex yet delicate floral candy sweetness. Paired with mild Peruvian chocolate, the flavor is refreshing with lingering umami and a creamy texture.

name: Fossa Honey Orchid Dancong Hongcha Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar is a collaboration chocolate with rare tea curator - Pekoe & Imp. Winner of the International Chocolate Awards 2019 Gold Award winner, it has lingering lychee sweetness with a biscuity undertone.

name: Fossa Jasmine Green Tea Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. This bar is a collaboration with rare tea curator Pekoe & Imp. It is a combination of Bi Tan Piao Xue (traditional Sichuan tea), a top-grade spring harvest green tea, and beautifully fragrant summer jasmine flowers. Made with Peruvian cacao, the result is a delicate & floral chocolate with notes of umami.

name: Fossa Lapsang Souchong Wuyi Cliff Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Traditional smoked Lapsang Souchong from Guadun Village, one of the twelve natural hamlets of Tongmuguan in Wuyi Mountains at 1200m is one of the world’s first black tea.

Crafted from 120-year-old Wuyi Cai Cha bushes grown among misty cliffs and ancient forests, their deep roots and slow growth produce leaves rich in minerals. Processed in a traditional pine-wood smoke house, it delivers both strength and elegance. Paired with cacao from Semuliki Forest, Uganda, the flavour is bold and aromatic with deep fruity sweetness beneath the smoke.

name: Fossa Matcha & Yuzu Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar is made with "Wakatake" grade matcha -the highest grade of culinary matcha- from Japan’s highly regarded matcha producer, Marukyu Koyamaen. The matcha has a good balance of richness and umami while its bright green colour is a feast for the eyes. Made into a creamy white chocolate and paired with citrusy candied yuzu peels, this makes for the perfect tea time snack.

name: Fossa Mu Zha Tie Guan Yin Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Mu Zha Tie Guan Yin is a Taiwanese roasted oolong tea crafted using a traditional method involving repeated rolling and masterful roasting. The tedious process produces tightly curled leaves that infuse toasty caramel aroma and fruity notes that evolves into a floral sweetness. This bar blends the tea with herbaceous and earthy Ecuadorian cacao from Costa Esmeraldas estate, creating a 62% dark chocolate that is comforting on a chilly day.

name: Fossa Pineapple Tart Caramelized Chocolate Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar of creamy caramelised blond chocolate contains pineapple chunks, buttery crusts and has a biscuity texture. Inspired by a favourite local festive snack, its addictive flavour is sure to leave you wanting more! Bite into the abundance of prosperity and blessings!

name: Fossa Pistachio Rose Cranberry 64% Dark Milk Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Pistachio and rose are made for each other. In a rose-infused 64% dark milk chocolate made with fruity cacao from the Philippines, Italian pistachios are folded in for a satisfying crunchy texture. Generous toppings of dehydrated cranberries and French rose petals makes this bar a wonderful harmony of flavours and textures.

name: Fossa Planteray Xaymaca Rum 72% Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

A collaboration between Planteray Rum and homegrown artisan chocolate maker Fossa Chocolate.

Tanzanian cacao from Kokoa Kamili fermentary is infused with Planteray Xaymaca Special Dry Rum, a Jamaican style rum fermented with natural wild yeast, and distilled in double retort pot stills.

Made into a 72% dark chocolate, the result is chocolate with rich aroma of overripe banana and tropical fruits with lingering finish of heavy and textured rum.

name: Fossa Rou Gui Wuyi Cliff Tea bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Rougui, named for its distinct cinnamon aroma, is a classic tea cultivar from the Wuyi Mountains. This batch is made from tea leaves harvested from Da Shui Keng which sits in the Ban Yan zone of Wuyi Mountains at over 800m. Here, the slopes flatten slightly, allowing the tea bushes to absorb sunlight throughout the entire day. Grown without chemical fertilisers nor pesticides, nurtured by the natural rhythm of the mountains, its flavour reflects the terroir.

Paired with cacao from Semuliki Forest, Uganda, the flavour is clean, vibrant and richly aromatic.

name: Fossa Sake Kasu 73% Dark Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

name: Fossa Salted Egg Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Caramelized white chocolate provides the base for this unique bar. Inspired by the beloved salted egg yolk dishes that are ubiquitous in Singaporean casual dining, it’s an addictive combination of sweet and savory. A truly delicious and creative white chocolate!

name: Fossa Satay Sauce Milk Chocolate Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

The travelling satay hawker who prepared skewered meat with a portable charcoal grill was a familiar sight in olden days Singapore. These barbecued skewers are the perfect comfort food and are never served without a dipping sauce made from ground peanuts and aromatic spices. Enjoy this traditional snack in a milk chocolate bar made with cacao sourced from Kokoa Kamili, Tanzania, and ingredients sourced regionally.

name: Fossa Soy Milk & Youtiao Bar, 50g
tagline: Creamy, aromatic soy with crunchy bits of tiao in white chocolate!
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Youtiaos are perfectly deep-fried golden brown strips of wheat flour dough. Crispy and chewy, they make great snacks on their own but the real enjoyment is dipping them into a warm bowl of nutritious soy milk. In this bar, dehydrated youtiaos are paired with 38% soy white chocolate to create this classic dish in bar form!

name: Fossa Terada Honke Kaikoshu Sake Chocolate, 50g
tagline: Oxidative, nutty & umami, reminiscent of elegant aged sake
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Sake and chocolate are perfect together. In this bar, an 18 years old junmai sake brewed in Terada Honke, a Chiba-based brewwery that makes natural, old-school sake using traditional manual methods, is infused into Tanzanian cacao from Kokoa Kamili fermentary. Made into a 72% dark chocolate, the flavor is complex with notes of preserved plums and warm spices.

name: Fossa Thai Lychee Nib Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Flower children, this one’s for you! This bar features rose tea-infused Tanzanian chocolate, sprinkled with dehydrated Thai lychee and cacao nibs. Its crunchy texture, fruity flavor & floral aroma will transport you straight to the garden with your first bite.

name: Fossa Xing Ren Hu Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Xing Ren Hu, also known as Chinese almond cream, is a delicate and silky traditional dessert first brought to Singapore by Teochew immigrants. Made with apricot kernel, rice, sugar and water, this smooth, ivory-hued paste offers a subtly nutty aroma with a lightly floral undertone.

In this bar, they toasted apricot kernel and grounded aromatic Jasmine rice for a smooth texture with a marzipan aroma. Bits of roughly chopped apricot kernel adds a playful crunch.

name: Fossa Yuzu Sea Salt Bar 54% Dark Milk, 50g
tagline: Creamy, biscuity chocolate with refreshing citrusy yuzu!
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Yuzu is an incredibly aromatic citrus fruit that has the ablility to brighten any dish and is commonly used in Japanese cuisine. This bar has chewy yuzu peel with sea salt flakes on a bed of creamy, biscuity Tanzania 54% dark milk chocolate. Perfect for your afternoon tea!

name: Goodnow Farms Asochivite Maple Suger 70% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

This bar is crafted with freshly pressed Asochivite cocoa butter for intense single origin flavor and exceptional smoothness. Goodnow Farms is one of the only chocolate makers in the country to press their own cocoa butter, and it makes a world of difference in flavor.

name: Goodnow Farms Caramelized Onion 77%, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

This sweet and savory bar combines our El Carmen chocolate with caramelized onions sourced from single origin spice masters Ethan Frisch and Ori Zohar of Burlap & Barrel. The carefully dried, caramelized onions are refined along with their chocolate in their stone grinders for maximum flavor development. The intense, melt-in-your mouth onion flavor is umami at its best. It's truly a unique and supremely satisfying flavor experience!

name: Goodnow Farms Chocolate Banana Split 59% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

Limited Release, Chocolate Banana Split by Goodnow Farms is a playful yet sophisticated take on the classic dessert. This small-batch chocolate combines rich single-origin cacao with the natural sweetness of ripe bananas, complemented by hints of vanilla and caramelized sugar.The result is a creamy, indulgent bar with a smooth texture and a nostalgic yet refined flavor profile. Perfect for those who love the comforting taste of a banana split with the depth of fine chocolate.

name: Goodnow Farms Coco Loco 60% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

This bar was inspired by their favorite Colombian beach cocktail, the Coco Loco, a drink they discovered in Cartagena during one of their cacao sourcing trips. There are many variations on the recipe but Goodnow love the combination of coconut, rum and citrus. To make this bar they had to find just the right balance of flavors to accentuate the chocolate, so they did a LOT of test batches. This final recipe involves soaking their fruity Esmeraldas cacao nibs in Boston Harbor Distillery’s Lawley’s Rum and adding just the right amount of organic coconut sugar, organic coconut milk powder, and naranjilla fruit to their grinders.

name: Goodnow Farms Guatemala Asochivite 77% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow craft their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolates on their New England farmstead, using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans. The payoff is some truly delicious chocolate!

The cacao for this dark chocolate comes from San Juan Chivite, a Guatemalan village so remote that a narrow footbridge is the only way in or out – yes, even for the cacao! The farm is run by indigenous Maya families, who were recently able to improve their fermentation facilities due to an investment from Goodnow. These talented farmers grow and ferment some excellent beans, and they are beautifully showcased in this bar. Bright and fruity, with light acidity and a dark fruit finish, this single origin chocolate is a pure delight.

name: Goodnow Farms Mexico Almendra 77% Bar, 55g
description: Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans. Almendra Blanca, or white almond, refers to the color of the cacao bean. There is nothing added to this bar - no almonds, just chocolate. Sourced from Hacienda Jesus Maria, a farm located in Tabasco, these unique beans lend a paler hue to this high-cacao bar. A short, gentle roast allows Goodnow to highlight the naturally bright, fruity flavor of the Almendra Blanca bean.

name: Herbaceous Green Sichuan Pepper 70% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

Their Herbaceous Green Sichuan Dark Chocolate sourced from spice company 50 Hertz is truly unique. They always pair the natural flavor notes of our single origin chocolate with different complementary flavors, and this match up is spectacular. The herbal notes of their Peruvian Ucayali chocolate seamlessly meld with and carry the pine, floral and citrus notes of the Green Sichuan Pepper. And, the Ucayali chocolate already had a slightly cooling hit, but the Sichuan really amps it up for a cool breeze in the mouth after the lemon rush! Also, not spicy!

name: K+M Extravirgin 75% Ecuador Dark Chocolate, 70g
description: Michelin-starred Chef Thomas Keller of The French Laundry in Napa Valley and Armando Manni, producer of legendary Italian olive oils, collaborated to develop some of the world’s finest chocolate with their proprietary method of custom processing each batch of cacao. Their 75% Dark Chocolate, Ecuador has a velvety texture and notes of ripe mango, spice, and sweet nectar.

name: K+M Milk Chocolate Truffle Fries 55% Bar, 55g
description:
Michelin-starred Chef Thomas Keller of The French Laundry in Napa Valley and Armando Manni, producer of legendary Italian olive oils, collaborated to develop some of the world’s finest chocolate with their proprietary method of custom processing each batch of cacao.

Inspired by the namesake side at Chef Thomas Keller's Bouchon Bistro, Truffle Fries combines lightly salted, crunchy French Fries and bean-to-bar milk chocolate with a hint of truffle. Crafted with Arriba Nacional cacao from Ecuador's Hacienda Victoria Estate and Rio Caribe beans from Venezuela's Paria Peninsula. Roasted, ground and molded by hand in Napa Valley, California.

name: Mission 70% Guava Bar, 60g
description:
Mission has been working with chocolate since 2002, first as chocolate educators with Le Cordon Bleu in Los Angeles, then as chocolatiers with their own store in Berkeley, California, and now as chocolate makers in São Paulo, Brazil. Their chocolates are the most awarded in Brazil, with 50 national and international prizes in the last 5 years. They believe the best chocolate rewards everyone in the supply chain. Their farmers receive almost 4 times more than the market price, orFair Trade pricing - they buy directly from the producer, no middle person involved.

This bar is made with only cacao, sugar and mini candied guava chunks dotted on top. The tropical fruit & rich dark chocolate are in perfect balance, giving you a little hint of the tropics in every bite without being overpowering.
